You sow Staghorn Sumac: 730 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 60 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
Martina speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the tree line. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)
💡 German is starting to make sense. You catch the shape of sentences now.
You accept Thornfield's food — 2,105 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Talia clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
Ava heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Eulogy gorges at the treeline — 1,100 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
That night, they bring Owen home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.
Village meal: +2313 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 180 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 125 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Snow by morning. (-7°C — Freezing) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
Martina Schwarz reads the sky: snow tomorrow, freezing.
The cold works on everyone — the village wakes aching from the deep cold.
🎁 Talia of Thornfield walks in with pack-mules and full baskets: 2,105 kcal, into Haven's bins — real pieces, honestly counted. "Eat. We'll settle the books when the green comes back."
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
✨ SYNERGY DISCOVERED: Everybody's Friend!
Talk pretty. Then listen harder.
📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""
⚡ SYNERGY WITNESSED: Everybody's Friend!
The cistern is dry. Haul from a creek (risky water), or put someone on water duty.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
💧 Ava returns with water: +4 clean.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 1L carried (1kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 3L left.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📯 It moves.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 1L carried (1kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 2L left.
